new_findings.issue: The SafeMath order fix makes the order of the two checked products explicit (one can fail with Panic(18), the other with Panic(17)), but prints the first product's overflow test as the raw 'a * b / b != a and b' idiom and recomputes the division three times.
new_findings.rule: To fix the order of checked operations, bind the first one to a variable in a statement before the expression (_t = SafeMath.mul(u, SafeMath.div(...)); if _t > SafeMath.mul(...)) instead of expanding its overflow test.

notes: Reviewed by structure (2715-line diff, 5 fill/simulate functions). Calls, logs, requires and ifs per function unchanged; the extra 2 Panic(17) reverts in fillContractOrder and fillOrder are the order fix above. The 6 raw 'call address(_param5) with: args mem[mem[64] len ...]' taker transfers were already raw (P2) in round 1. summary: No semantic regression; one low readability regression: writes before calls print as mem[mem[64] + k] while the call reads mem[_N len ...]. The selectors are now resolved, return-data reverts and results are direct, and the fill functions are shorter; the duplicated _fill tail remains.
